# CI build tools, pinned exactly (OneFuzz lift, 2026-10-18: a
# floating install lets a compromised or broken upstream release
# enter the build silently). Workflows install with this file as
# the constraint set -- `pip install -c .github/requirements-ci.txt
# <tool>` -- so each job still installs only the tools it uses,
# but every version comes from here and nowhere else.
#
# Each pin below is what the previously floating install
# resolved to on the day it was pinned; Dependabot's pip
# ecosystem watches this file and proposes the bumps.

pytest==9.1.1
build==1.6.1
mutmut==3.8.0
pyrefly==1.4.0
pyinstaller==6.22.3
